text.title: One day at Antelope Canyon for 203 dollars

cafe.name: Ranch House Grille, 819 N Navajo Dr
cafe.order: the green chili omelette with Western hash browns
cafe.when: opens 6am daily, closes 2pm — beat the 8am rush

dish.name: the Navajo taco on frybread
dish.tip: Big enough to split; they close between 2pm and 4pm

spot.name: Upper Antelope Canyon
spot.how: guided Navajo tour only, no walk-ups

items: Upper Antelope Canyon tour, 11am beam slot — $154
Green chili omelette at Ranch House Grille — $18.50
Coffee and a donut at Hot n Sweet — $3.50

text.mistake: Arizona skips daylight saving; the Navajo Nation does not. Tours run on Page time, so a phone that flips zones on US-89 makes you an hour late. No refund.
text.close: Send this to whoever books the 11am slot
